using CUDA, JSON3
CUDA.allowscalar(false)
function main()
    n = 8
    u = CUDA.CuArray(collect(1.0:n)); v = CUDA.CuArray(fill(2.0, n))
    uh = Array(u); vh = Array(v)
    r = Dict{String,Any}("device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))
    r["truth_full"]    = sum(uh .* vh)                 # loop 1:n
    r["truth_partial"] = sum(uh[2:n] .* vh[2:n])       # loop 2:n
    t(k, f) = try r[k] = f() catch e; r[k] = "ERR: " * first(sprint(showerror, e), 120) end
    t("mapreduce_full",      () -> mapreduce(*, +, u, v))
    t("mapreduce_view",      () -> mapreduce(*, +, view(u, 2:n), view(v, 2:n)))
    t("mapreduce_view_full", () -> mapreduce(*, +, view(u, 1:n), view(v, 1:n)))
    t("mapreduce_view_step", () -> mapreduce(*, +, view(u, 1:2:n), view(v, 1:2:n)))
    r["truth_step"] = sum(uh[1:2:n] .* vh[1:2:n])
    println(JSON3.write(Dict("probe" => r)))
end
main()
